data.name: Dalpati
data.gender_notes: Dalpati is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dalpati is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dal’ (to strike) and ‘pati’ (lord). This name is given to a brave warrior or a fearless leader. It is often used as a name for boys born into warrior or royal families. The name Dalpati carries the meaning “Brave in battle” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dalpati usually hope their child will grow to embody brave in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bravery in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Dalpati belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave in battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dalpati total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dalpati holds great cultural significance in Hindu society. It is a name that evokes images of strength, courage, and leadership. The name is often given to boys born into warrior or royal families, reflecting the warrior spirit and courage that are essential qualities for a leader. In epics like the Mahabharata and the Ramayana, characters with similar names display remarkable valor and fearlessness, further solidifying the cultural meaning and impact of the name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dalpati signifies inner strength and fearlessness in the face of adversity. It encourages the bearer to embrace challenges with courage and never back down from doing what is right. The name also symbolizes devotion to a higher power, as a true warrior or leader relies on divine guidance and protection. Ultimately, the name Dalpati is a reminder to always strive for inner strength and fearlessness in the spiritual journey of life.
